title: Government Deleveraging and the Reverse Crowding-In Effect: Evidence from Subnational Debt and Government Contractors
authors: Jiayin Hu; Songrui Liu; Yang Yao; Zhu Zong
eligible_reason: Common date: GP_post = Gov_Purch_firm2 x post17q2 (03_merge_quarter.do line 490; annual GP_post = Gov_Purch_firm x (year>=2017), 04_merge_annual.do line 62). Every government contractor is treated at 2017Q2 (China's deleveraging campaign); city-level analysis uses high_repay_post = after_high_repayment x (year>=2017). Not staggered. Most columns also include time-varying firm controls ($control_var) and industry x M2-growth slopes.
design_notes: Stata. CSMAR listed firms, quarterly (seasonal.dta) and annual (annual.dta) panels. Table 2: reghdfe ar_ratio_w GP_post $control_var, abs(stkcd time_index) or abs(stkcd industry#quarter industry#c.m2_growth time_index), cl(stkcd). Tables 3-4: POE/SOE splits and DDD (GP_post_poe, GP_post_high). Tables 5-8: working capital, investment, operating performance, ownership changes. Figure 3: quarterly event study around 2017Q2. Robustness: alternative contractor definitions, placebo date (GP_post_fake), ivreghdfe.

specs.exclusion_reason: common treatment date (2017Q2); time-varying controls; industry x M2-growth slopes in cols 2+

data_files_note: Derived analysis files shipped; raw CSMAR/CEIC/Wind inputs licensed (README lists sources).
data_provenance_note: Authors' derived panels from CSMAR/Wind/CEIC and procurement records.
screener_notes: Data shipped but design is a single 2017 shock; not staggered.
